presentation.speaker: jun_ito
presentation.title: Flood-damaged car on your lot
lines: Jun spotted water lines under the carpet of a car you bought at auction. Disclose it and cut the price, pay for a repair, or list it quietly and hope.

choices.label: Disclose the flood damage
choices.outcome: The car is priced as a flood car; no claims will follow.

choices.label: Pay for a proper repair
choices.outcome: The repair removes most of the damage but costs money and workshop days.

choices.label: List it quietly
choices.outcome: A buyer may find the damage later: a refund claim and a consumer fine are likely.
